"dmx-corp-prod-1212" destination zone on Rule no.774; MSA-SBC-to-AFI-SBC-For-Teams-Voice-sdwan on NHQ-Corp firewall. Determine the Root Cause: Communication between the MSA voice Session Border Controller (SBC) and the AmFam voice session border controllers, was requested on 10/03/2022 via RITM2290294. Source Static IP MSA SBC 172.16.150.179 Source NAT IP MSA SBC 10.176.94.179 Destination IP NHQ 10.246.212.19 Destination IP GRL 10.248.212.19 Bidirectional RTP Port Range 30383-31382 Bidirectional SIP Port UDP-5060 And Vice-Versa between source and destination During the March 2022 timeframe, communication between AMFAM and MSA and vice versa is routed through the Transit zone via firewalls. The following path depicts the traffic flow without SDWAN. On NHQ-Corp Firewall: dmz-corp-prod-1212 -> trust On AFI-Tenant : AFI-WAN -> AFI-Transit On MSA-Tenant: MSA-Transit -> MSA-WAN On MSA-DC: MPLS -> dc-server-farm Vice-Versa On MSA-DC: dc-server-farm -> MPLS On MSA-Tenant: MSA-WAN -> MSA-Transit On AFI-Tenant : AFI-Transit -> AFI-WAN On NHQ-Corp Firewall: trust -> dmz-corp-prod-1212 In August 2023, SDWAN was introduced for the MSA and AMFAM networks by ETS-ENS in partnered with Cyber Defense Border Technologies team. The traffic path between the AMFAM and MSA firewalls has been altered, with the transit zone firewalls removed from the path. During the process of updating the SDWAN rules on firewalls, it was not noticed to update zone "dmz-corp-prod-1212" on firewall security policy Rule no.735; AFI-SBC-to-MSA-SBC-For-Teams-Voice-sdwan and Rule no.774; MSA-SBC-to-AFI-SBC-For-Teams-Voice-sdwan on the NHQ-Corp firewall. Moreover, the connectivity between the MSA voice Session Border Controller (SBC) and the AmFam voice Session Border Controllers was never tested post SDWAN implementation. And the communication issue was reported on May 13, 2024 via INC3857198, and we implemented the firewall change CHG2122021 - RITM2641976 to allow the communication indicated below:- "dmx-corp-prod-1212" source zone on Rule no.735; AFI-SBC-to-MSA-SBC-For-Teams-Voice-sdwan on NHQ-Corp firewall. At the moment policy are getting validated during quote if it's a transition policy and having AFI partner, regardless of if the policy was already verified or type of transaction. The code triggering the validation looks to be old code.

PolicyServiceGateway.gs #97

Workaround: unarchive the policy and wait for 24hrs to reflect in fusion. We could also temporarily disable script parameter 'EnableLegacyPolicyNumberValidation' and try to quote as workaround.

I will work with WebHp tomorrow to get these two Apache instances restarted to re-establish the connection back.  [05/06/2024][19:31:06.502][187835][343881472][*10.86.191.30][][POST][/iam/im/TEWS6/amfam_myaccount_users][Communication failure between SiteMinder policy server and web agent.][CSmLowLevelAgent.cpp:1380][AuthenticateUser][amfam_myaccount_users_TEWS6_realm][identitymanager][0000000000000000000000000ae3560a-2ddbb-6639764a-147f3700-c3ed3fc3f076][]
Close notes:
There is nothing wrong with the External IDM (identity Manager) or it's codebase on NHQ and GRL. Issue is two Apache nodes in NHQ (papp217di and papp218di) just lost the connection with the SiteMinder Policy Server. As a result of that, Requests that are sent to these two NHQ nodes and getting HTTP 302 response where it is redirecting the requests over to a My Account Maintenance page.

Error: SiteMinder Agent Api function failed - 'Sm_AgentApi_LoginEx' returned '-1'.
Sm_AgentApi_IsProtectedEx, ' is function call of an agent. This function returns -1 or -2 on error 
-1 means that it has failed to communicate with the server
-2 means time-out
Agents connect to the Policy Server using a three way handshake. These error will occur after the agent sends its initial hello message to the policy server.
If the policy server does not respond back with its hello message within a stipulated time , these error are returned.
This condition could be due to a policy server side issue (starvation) where policy server lacks the resources to respond fast enough to the web agent.

Initially prddi25 is set as active/active on NHQ and GRL. Usually it supposed to be in active/passive model. But anyways, during the MI - we point the prddi25 to GRL which is currently acting as Active and NHQ is set as Passive.

After the MI, I worked with Web HP unit to restart the Apache instances of papp217di and papp218di and after the Apache restart - these Apache instances are able to reestablish the connection back with the SiteMinder Policy Server.

Working with the monitoring team to place appropriate monitoring in place on SiteMinder and identity Manger to catch these issues early.

In the problem ticket, a task is already dispatched to the monitoring team.

Problem statement: Common: Fusion: User having edit submission/renewal permission ability to navigate to page 2 of documents
Description:
Description: User having edit submission/renewal permission is unable to navigate to page of the documents when there are 2 pages of the documents the transaction (Submission/Renewal) which is not completed (In quoted or draft status and not bound yet)

Root cause: Document list view raw iterator is editable in the document screen. As per the OOTB code if its editable, navigation ability is disabled.

When user is having edit submission/renewal permission and transaction is not completed, transaction is opened in edit mode and document list also opened in edit mode (parent open in edit is true) and user ability is disabled.

When user is not having edit submission/renewal permission or transaction is completed, transaction is not opened in edit mode and document list view opened in edit mode (parent open in edit is false) and user ability is enabled.

Steps to replicate:
Open any not completed transaction (Sub/Ren, Status:Draft/Quoted) with a user having edit submission/renewal permission.
Transaction should have enough documents so that there should be at least 2 pages of documents (For Ex: 20 documents)
Open document screen and search documents, so that there should be at least 2 pages of documents.

Workaround: Complete the transaction to see all pages or login with a user not having edit submission/renewal permission to see all pages.
Close notes: Closing PRB based on discussion, there is no issue with the Agent Transfer.   This is a process issue, when a back-term change is being completed, and a script is required to update to the old producer.

Problem statement: Major Incident | Homesite Genesys Degreated Performance
Description: Multiple users are reporting Homesite Genesys is lagging.
Cause notes:
From Root Cause Analysis PTASK2015527

Cause Code:
vendor issue

Cause Notes:

Preliminary root cause analysis and timeline for the case 0003471727

 

29-Mar 18:16 UTC - Case 0003471727 created to investigate lags in ACW 

29-Mar 19:37 UTC – Genesys team has initiated a process of log collection with Homesite team, which took several attempts because the issue was intermittent and sporadic

1-Apr (multiple times) – 2 Call examples provided - no HAR/Console logs so analysis into any delays was limited. 

23-Apr (multiple times) - 2 Call examples provided - no HAR/Console logs so analysis was limited.

23-Apr (Maintenance Window) – Genesys performed GWS upgrade which included a transition to the new backend architecture

30-Apr - Large scale service interruption reported and all teams engaged to actively troubleshoot issue. 

30-Apr 14:45 UTC – Engineering team has been engaged to investigate GWS backend issue 

30-Apr 16:45 UTC – Logs have been collected and provided for analysis

30-Apr 17:25 UTC – Incident declared 

30-Apr 18:56 UTC – Engineering team has identified the issue as constrained network on nginx and applied corrective steps to resolve the issue 

30-Apr 19:51 UTC – no errors are reported following the workaround being applied to rebalance network load on backend infrastructure components

01-May 13:50 UTC – Homesite team has reported issue reoccurring 

01-May 15:31 UTC – priority increased to critical based on significant production impact 

01-May 17:40 UTC – Engineering team has applied another workaround and restarted nginx nodes 

01-May 19:25 UTC – Further reports of the issue received 

01-May 19:46 UTC – Backend infrastructure was upscaled from 14 to 22 nodes in total (4 nginx nodes to 8 nginx nodes) to allow additional network capacity 

02-May 03:40 UTC – Migration to the alternative ingress solution (Target Group Binding) was performed and tested successfully 

02-May 03:50 UTC – Incident resolved 

03-May 17:43 UTC – Resolution is confirmed by Homesite team

08-May 11:42 UTC – Priority of the case decreased to high as issue is mitigated 

 

What happened: on 30 Apr delays in the Agent Desktop UI started to affect agents while changing status to ACW or during inbound call alerting. Issues affected substantial proportion of the agents (70%) and significantly impacted productivity. 

 

Why the issue happened: Agent Desktop UI is using CometD to maintain connection with the Genesys Web Services (GWS) backed components. Issue happened due to a large number of CometD errors, which started to occur following the transition to the new backend architecture. In scope of the new service architecture solution was moved from AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS) to Kubernetes cluster and new components were added in the path of the API traffic prior to it reaching GWS services. Adding those new components introduced drops of long-running TCP connections and resulted, in turn, in CometD errors.

Cause notes:
From Root Cause Analysis PTASK2015484

Cause Code:
people process documentation

Cause Notes:

The process of sending users to that link, which is meant for a small subset of users, cause system canvas error. 

Canvas errors can be cause by a variety of reasons, but this one in particular was related to a large MI. Notifications were sending everyone in receipt to the MI workbench, which is not meant to be accessed as such (the workbench is only to be used by those working incidents). As a result, the platform experienced stability issues.

This conversation ensued over Teams, which resulted in Story SNPLAT-987 to fix the root cause of this particular canvas error.
Close notes:

During the vCenter MI on 4/15, three topics were identified for further discussion and potential action.

Cascading updates between the parent (MI) and the children can create excessive load on the SN system

Notifications to the MI owner can become overwhelming (some reports showed 9000+ notification messages being sent during the MI)

When MI updates are sent, the link included links to the MI Workbench.  This may be necessary for IT staff involved in support, but is not necessary for general users.  With so many users clicking on this link, excessive load is being generated.

Likely these will need to be considered together, hence a single spike.  This may result in multiple stories to actually make system changes.

This development work is currently scheduled for Sprint 14.

Problem statement: Unable to launch ComLink, it states it's "Currently unavailable and to "Please close your browser and try again.
Description: Unable to launch ComLink, it states it's "Currently unavailable and to "Please close your browser and try again. If this message persists, please contact the Help Desk"
Cause notes:
From Root Cause Analysis PTASK2015344

Cause Code:
environmental disaster

Cause Notes:

On 4/15, there was a Major Incident - INC3808550 that impacted multiple applications. The Major incident on 4/16 is caused to the side effects of MI 4/15. We learnt that MQ queue managers were restarted on 4/15 and following that multiple partitions were also restarted to re-establish MQ connection to the applications. However, ClaimCenter, ClaimLocator, DDCS and other application related partitions were not restarted nor these teams were notified with these instructions. ClaimCenter On-call noticed that Messages transports that use MQs were getting piled up with messages on 4/15 night and restarted the partition/jvms(per suggestion from MQ Admin team) for ClaimCenter, ClaimLocator and DDCS. This way, all the messages transports regained connection to MQ and thousands of stuck messages got processed.

Out of the ClaimCenter transports mentioned above, ClaimInfo transport sends the data to ClaimLocator. Since ClaimLocator was also impacted and lost connectivity with MQ. The messages processed from ClaimCenter application went to Dead Letter queue(5k+). During the MI on 4/16, messages from Dead letter queue were processed with the help of MQ Admin team and for the messages that were lost due to ClaimLocator application restart, were inserted into claimlocator table using a sql script. 

Since the claims were not available in the ClaimLocator table due to above MQ issues, there was an issue viewing these claims in CommLink.

Problem statement: Multiple applications down in production
Description:
Review PIR: 
Incident was proposed due to multiple applications that were hosted on virtual machines being down, and applications that make call to these applications that are hosted virtually being impacted. Infrastructure and application support teams joined a bridge to determine the cause of this, which was tied to a requested change to add a new host to a cluster that also resulted in a port change on both of the Cisco FI's connected to the vCenter server. The change was reverted and VM's did not come back up on the network automatically, with multiple missing an IP address. Support teams performed restarts of multiple application and MQ servers which brought the applications back up.
Cause notes:
From Root Cause Analysis PTASK2015322

Cause Code:
people process documentation

Cause Notes:

The Production Nutanix clusters (NHQ1PC40 & NHQ1PC41) are Hyper-converged Infrastructure which means they share all the storage that is in each physical host in the cluster.  This storage looks like one storage LUN to the virtual machines.  This infrastructure has redundancy and is able to lose 2 of the hosts without causing any problems with the storage but when a 3rd host is lost the storage goes into a read-only state.  This causes the virtual machines (Linux & Windows) to put their storage into a read-only mode since it can't update it's storage. When the cable was plugged into port 32 which was configured as a Network port the VMs started to send some traffic to it but because it wasn't truly a Network uplink it dropped the packets causing the hosts to lose network connectivity.  This in turn caused the VMs to mark their storage as unavailable or in read-only mode.  When port 32 was disabled and all network traffic went to the 2 normal network uplinks the hosts responded again.  Most Windows server recovered fine by the linux servers needed to reboot to recover from the read-only mode.
Close notes: The Port 32 on the FI was disabled.  The stopped the network traffic from going down port 32 and being dropped.

When this service is stopped, the MVR details are not received instantly on the same transaction, which causes an inaccurate mapping of MVR_IDs to the wrong driver in QFR when any driver deletions or additions are done during endorsement. 

There is no impacted policies yet in production because the HS-36737 went live on 08/26/2023 and policies will come for renewal on 08/26/2024, if we consider the renewal image days say 90, then the renewal would be by 05/28/2024. As a result, policies that fall on or after this date will be impacted if the endorsement includes the scenarios listed above. Here's an example of this.

Policy: Two drivers have been added to NB with the following MVR data.
C_MVR_ORDER_GID | DRIVER_NO | AUDIT_FLAG
80884 1 null
80887 2 null

Driver-1 is removed from Endorsement and Driver-3 is added without providing MVR details (i.e., no MVR service is called) as follows:
C_MVR_ORDER_GID | DRIVER_NO | AUDIT_FLAG
80884 1 E
80887 2 null
null 3 A   

In QFR, the driver numbers re-arrange, and the C_MVR_ORDER_GIDs are improperly mapped, as shown below.
C_MVR_ORDER_GID | DRIVER_NO | AUDIT_FLAG
80887 1 null
80887 2 null
Driver-1 is no longer displayed in QFR because it was deleted in Endorsement, and Driver-2 became Driver-1 with the correct C_MVR_ORDER_GID since its available in New Business transaction, but the newly added Driver-3 became Driver-2 with the (80887)C_MVR_ORDER_GID of Driver-2 from New Business.

Problem statement: Homesite  Agents - Genesys - Not able to See Favorites Used for Transferring Calls
Description: Homesite solutions customer service center issue with missing targets in genesis
Cause notes:
From Root Cause Analysis PTASK2015271

Cause Code:
vendor issue

Cause Notes:

Genesys updated configuration in WWE to avoid calls being transferred to custom contacts.
As a result of that favorites got impacted.



From Root Cause Analysis PTASK2015271

Cause Code:
vendor issue

Cause Notes:

Genesys updated configuration in Workspace Web Edition (WWE) to avoid calls being transferred to custom contacts. Update was done due to an incident (INC3745179 ) that we received. As per the incident the calls were getting transferred to a Progressive client due to the clients number being saved in to Genesys as a Custom Contact.
The result of the change impacted also the favorites not showing up on the transfers.

Validation was done after the change in UAT environment which was successful as the change resulted in the contacts not being displayed. However the UAT environment does not have Favorites hence the actual issue that happened in Prod was not caught in UAT environment.
Close notes:
Reached out Genesys and asked them to revert back the change, which resolved the issue.
For future fix the change would be done locally by adding a filter in Prod for couple of agents and validated for couple of weeks before rolling the change out to all the agents globally. Change with alternate approach deployed with CHG2119779

Problem statement: Docviewer is not working after new P8 changes
Description: We have completed the upgrade of the P8 system (CHG2117899) and that worked as expected (as best as we can tell).  But, we have run into a problem with the Doc Viewer application as it needed to be redeployed after P8 upgrade was complete.  Other Document services such as Document Federation Service, ICN, and Bulkloader are working.
Cause notes:
From Root Cause Analysis PTASK2015259

Cause Code:
software issue

Cause Notes:

Some application classes are not loaded after application deployment.


From Root Cause Analysis PTASK2015259

Cause Code:
Undetermined

Cause Notes:

Some application classes are not loaded after application deployment.

This app was working a week back before these new servers were shut down for DB data sync.

Post DB sync and a clean synced restart all other applications came up just fine.

The issue was troubleshot and at one point a quick restart was done to see if it can fix the issue.

It however did not fix it and IBM was involved since no changes had been done in WAS or app level. They suggested to turn traces on and during MI it was agreed to turn traces on one node and check it.

A class loader issues was identified by IVM but for ECMS application deployment. Also post a clean synced restart again after setting up traces that node came up fine and started working for Doc viewer.

The end user still continued to report issues. IHS for both instances were restarted which fixed the issue momentarily after bringing it back again.

it was later realized that the other node also needed to go through a clean synced restart although traces were n0ot setup on this node.

Also, the traces were removed from the previous single node where it was set up earlier.

Post this all validations started working.

 

Root cause was attributed to the class path not loading correctly for only one application, which was corrected after the clean synced restart.
Close notes: Clean synced restart of the application servers a second time fixed the issue.

Description:

Problem: KYD, MMW, DMW
Description of Issue: Triage-7218 - ACRR-23209

The information on the policy review screen for the MMW Adjustment transactions don’t appear correct or seem highly fluctuated. We’re not sure of the accuracy of these, and in turn, of the premium adjustments. This is the info we’re seeing and the first listed is just a base transaction to start from:

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

0000HKV552 - on 11/4/23 eff 11/4/23 $18.79 charge from 46 to 230

0000HPH855 - on 12/4/23 eff 12/4/23 $12.61 credit from 230 to 0

0000HWH5M5 -  on 1/4/23 eff 1/4/24 $0.00 premium impact  from 0 to 78

0000HPH836 - on 1/29/24 eff 1/4/24, $19.42 charge from 0 to 360- was the original Dec. savings incorrect, what are we missing this this bot transaction?

0000J4FR6X - on 2/4/24 eff 2/4/24 $242.20 - credit from to not listed, just shows mileage driven as 304

On these transactions, one very odd thing is that each monthly transaction is on the 4th of the month, but we randomly have one happening on 01/29/2024, with an effective date of 01/04/2024, even though we had a transaction on 01/04/2024.

Another odd thing is that the mileage doesn’t seem to retain the last transaction’s mileage info. For example, on 11/4, we ended at 230 and then on 12/4, we start with 230. The 1/4/24 and 1/29 show a big jump, and then the most recent one doesn’t show the to/from, it just shows a mileage and a very large premium decrease, compared to other months. Cause notes:
Per I/S review; the system is working correctly.

The bot is currently working as expected, and only stops if there are large premium increases $>500 and 60 days old. In these situations, PC created two workflows, because one failed, the second was created and bound; and the bot picked up the failed one and bound it later. However the second work order created and bound first did not retrieve the correct data. The one bound by the bot on a later date was the correct score.

An enhancement is being done, so that the bot excludes telematic workorders. Services would get then get an activity to review and determine if the change should be bound.

I/S notes: 

There is an effort underway for redesigning how PLPC communicates with the enrollment system. Currently future dated transactions are sent from PLPC to the Enrollment System immediately and held in the enrollment system until they become effective. Enrollment System has not been designed to be a point in time system and runs into issues like this when it tries to do so. By Policy Center holding and maintaining the transactions on their end, and sending them when they are effective, will eliminate systematic issues with multiple future dated opt-ins and opt-outs.

Along with the effort of systematically fixing future dated transactions, we are also redesigning the procedural issues as well. For example splits (41102-41767-71 in this case), state to states, and spins have always been a pain point. The redesign includes returning a specific error message from Enrollment System indicating a specific action to take instead of erroring out. For example for a split, if a driver and phone number is currently enrolled on an old policy and trying to enroll on a new policy with the same phone number, we can return an error message telling PLPC to unenroll them from the old policy first. They can then systematically unenroll them from the old policy and then enroll them in the new policy when this error code gets returned.

So these issues cannot simply be fixed as part of a defect, and instead will take more than 200 hours and be addressed as part of our new future dated refactoring project. We will be scheduling a meeting to discuss this.

Problem statement: Common: UW cancel letter is not going out.
Description:
Description:  UW cancel letter is not going out because the requested date is before the earliest allowable date

Root Cause: As per system, the holiday lead time is calculating as initially it will add state specific lead time to the current date (cancel create date) then it will subtract one day and add next business day then it will calculate the days between current date and the date which we got after adding business days.

Error log: gw.api.job.JobStateException: Cannot schedule cancellation, the requested date, 04/14/2024, is before the earliest allowable date of 04/16/2024

Example: In the above case we created a cancellation(C020368707) on 20/03/2023 with effective date of 04/14/2024. But system expecting the effective date to be 04/16/2024 because it calculating as

Step 1:  24 (lead time) + 03/20/2024 (cancel create date) which is 04/13/2024(Saturday)
Step 2:  Subtracting 1 day i.e.., (04/13/2024 - 1 day) which is 04/12/2024(Friday)
Step 3:  Adding next business day which is 04/15/2024(Monday) excluding Weekends.
Step 4: Calculating the days between (04/15/2024 - 03/20/2024) i.e.., 26 days

Now, it will consider 26 days as final lead time and it will add it to Letter mailing date which is (03/21/2024) then that will be considering as Cancel Effective date (04/16/2024)

Class name: CancellationLeadTimeCalculator.gs
Method name: getHolidayLeadTime()

Workaround: Updated the system expected effective date using script
Close notes:
A validation has been introduced which will catch these scenarios before they're to happen.  However, the implementation of lead-time has ambiguity and would be an enhancement.  


Dubey, Piyush :
As part of PRB2008809, validation has been added on front-end, that will prevent cancellation letter from going out for those scenarios where there is discrepancy in lead time. For remaining scenarios, cancellation will get bind as expected

Because on dates, requirement is not clear. And what business expects, does not also get along with requirement-   Fixing the holiday lead time will have very minor impact on overall functionality. Big issue in this is the implementation of lead time. There is discrepancy in selection of lead time, during starting of cancellation and during binding the cancellation. Each occasion has different lead time, which triggers the validation and stops cancellation from binding.

Problem statement: Major Incident | Commercial V4 System not responding
Description: Commercial V4 System not responding.
Cause notes:
From Root Cause Analysis PTASK2015049

Cause Code:
software issue

Cause Notes:

  • There was a pending endorsement on the policy.​
  • Whenever there is a pending endorsement, system creates PENDINGRATE_ENDORSEMENT object to be executed in the batch.​
  • In this case, system was procreating multiple objects of PENDINGRATE_ENDORSEMENT for execution in nightly batch. This is due to an existing code glitch.​
  • In addition to this, there is a trigger on Batch Executor table which identifies transactions to be extracted to RDB. This trigger is incorrect and inserts multiple records of the same transaction.​
  • Due to above two issues, we had several thousand duplicate objects for the same policy in Batch Executor and millions of records in the RDB extraction table. This resulted in delay in batch processing.​

Problem statement: Major Incident | Slowness to quoting for PAS v11
Description: Majesco seeing high CPU usage - PAS users may see slowness
Configuration item: ESB IT Billing and Policy - PROD
Cause notes:
From Root Cause Analysis PTASK2015013

Cause Code:
software issue

Cause Notes:

After our detailed analysis of the recent two major incidents, 3/14 and 3/18, we have concluded that the underlying cause for both the occurrences is the same.

 

  • In our analysis, we found there were two long Garbage Collector pauses of about 4 seconds.
  • These triggered blocking threads on DB connection and security calls.
  • As threads were in waiting state it resulted in CPU usage fluctuation up to 95% on policy application server.
  • No issues on database noticed.
  • High CPU usage on policy application server resulted in slowness experienced by users. It also impacted response time of quote APIs.

The issue with the impacted claims is a system limitation on the way the City is entered at FNOL where the digital channel will allow the customer to enter the loss location city free form.  This stom was impacting O'Fallon, MO and most of the misrouted claims were entered without the apostrophe.

Workaround:
For Policy BPP1047215,

 

  1. Error is received from billing end stating that “Agent No. cannot be blank.”
  2. The query used to get the agent no is :

(SELECT producer_code
FROM VW_MIS_PRODUCERS prod
WHERE
prod.entity_reference = policy.entity_reference
AND
prod.producer_of_record = \'Y\'
AND rownum < 2
) BROKERNO

  1. For the reported policy the  producer_of_record field is marked as N in the MIS_PRODUCERS table.
  2. Ideally this should be Y. We checked the Rules and according to custom rules set the value should be Y.
  3. Also check in the database and there is no active policies with producer_of_record as N having producer_code as not null

 

SELECT producer_code,producer_of_record,entity_reference

FROM VW_MIS_PRODUCERS prod

WHERE

producer_code is not null AND

prod.producer_of_record = 'N';

 

  1. This policy is converted to V11 for renewal.
  2. The data patch needs to be perform to change the producer_of_record to Y.

select PSTA_DATE_GENERATE, PSTA_PROCESS_DATE,PSTA_PROCESS_FLAG,PSTA_SYS_ID, PSTA_TRANSACTION_TYPE, PSTA_ACTIVE_STATUS

and TRUNC(PSTA_DATE_GENERATE)='10-FEB-24';

  3. Because WhatFix was preventing TG claim adjusters to move forward with the Claim FNOL process, an MI was initiated with the thought that this affected all adjusters.
  4. After examination by Claims Center developers, the issue was determined to be the WhatFix application.  The WhatFix application was then unintalled on all TG Claim Adjuster desktops

Problem statement: ECP Auto quoting impacted due to offers failures
Description:
ECP COnnect offers are failing with below error

com.homesite.sapi.core.exception.ServiceNotAvailableException: {"code":500,"message":"Internal Server Error","errors":[{"domain":"provider","reason":"Error obtaining vendor data: CreditInfo => Details: Unable to process credit request: NODATA: Code:O.  Message:Other Error.","message":"Vendor","locationType":"","location":"AAHAutoApi"}]}
Cause notes:
From Root Cause Analysis PTASK2014853

Cause Code:
vendor issue

Cause Notes:

When daily batch jobs run, there is a final step to copy from the mainframe to Unix files. The logical
partition (LPAR), with ownership of any particular Unix directory, uses the CPU assigned to that LPAR
and, in this case, the ownership for the relevant Unix directory was with the wrong LPAR. Equifax asked
the mainframe vendor to change ownership back to the correct LPAR on Monday, March 4, 2024, but the
change was not executed properly. Therefore, when the batch jobs were completed, they used the
wrong LPAR to copy datasets and this, in conjunction with regular system load, caused production
transactions to slow down and mainframe CPU to spike to 100%.
Close notes:
Equifax has confirmed that the Unix directory has now been set statically to point to the correct LPAR.

Equifax canceled the batch jobs and recycled every region for the LPAR where they were running. After
recycling all of the regions, there were still hung transactions in the primary production systems.
Additional LPARs were recycled to restore service.

Problem statement: Roll Forward issue
Description:
Cancel Roll Forward issue- System set up a non-pay cancellation and it generate an activity- Automatic update error with the description - Roll forward error and user are not able to proceed with the Transaction. System throws a roll forward error when Term1 cancel is sent and Effective date for cancel for Term2 should be Renewal Effective date. 

Steps need to resolve- User can't reinstate the prior term.

1. Check if the non-pay cancellation is draft or in quoted status.

2. Request MSA Processing team to cancel the policy with effective renewal date.

3. Change the Roll Forward Indicator. 

    Open PC --> Administration-->Policy Correction tools--> Force Roll Forward Indicator Update-->Search with recent cancellation quote number--> Click on Load Job 

4. System will trigger Roll Forward indicator from 'False' to 'True'.

5. For a given job number or cancellation that is stuck in PE, the policy is corrected in E1P PC with roll forward indicator. 

6. Now user can reinstate the Term1 and Term2.

Cancel Roll Forward Flag- [EPCP-3993] Cancel Roll Forward flag - Jira (atlassian.net) 

Defect- [EPPS-653] Roll forward error: Cannot schedule cancellation, - Jira (atlassian.net)

Scenario 2: Cancellation on previous Term with a Renewal already effective

When a policy has a renewal that is already effective

The second Jenkins deploy job should not have been started. This is what caused the major incident.

Varun and I (PLPC Production Support) came up with a plan to get PolicyCenter started, but we want to test the process on our prod fix environment. A Delphix refresh was started at 1:39 a.m. If completed at 2:21 a..m.

The first attempt to start PolicyCenter on prod fix was meant to create the problem that was occurring in production. After this, the following SQL was run as the first attempt to fix the issue…

delete from pcowner.pc_systemparameter where Name = 'UpgradeInProgress';

The second attempt to start PolicyCenter on prod fix also failed. The following option was startup option was added…

-Dgw.pc.full.upgrade.intended.date=20240303

The third attempt to start PolicyCenter on prod fix was successful.

The plan was to run the SQL and add the startup option in production. To add the startup option, we needed help from IaC or the Web Team. I requested help at 2:54 a.m.

 

After talking with two or three others, we finally contacted Vijay Kasturi at 3:48 a.m.

Vijay added the startup option, then stopped ppcblcoa001 and tried to start, but it failed again.

We were thinking that we may need to use the database snapshot / restore point. We have never done this, and the DBA thought this would cause an issue for Attunity and GoldenGate, so we were hoping to avoid this.

I ran the Jenkins stop-tomcat job and then the bounce job for ppcblcoa001. This was successful.

I verified a few things in PolicyCenter, then ran the Jenkins bounce job for each of the other 29 servers. Once all six batch servers, I stared message queues and started five UI servers. Once this was done, the PLPC swing and other deploy steps were resumed. I started the remaining servers. All servers were started by 5:08 a.m. All deploy tasks were completed and batch started at 5:33 a.m.

Take-aways, room for improvement…

  • As previously stated, the second Jenkins deploy job should not have been started. We should have realized that starting ppcblcoa001 was still in progress, let it finish, then start the other servers.
  • Now that we know this process, if we get into this situation again, testing on prod fix may not be necessary, but should be considered.
  • For adding the startup option, we need to know which team to contact, and the person oncall should have the necessary access and instructions.

Problem statement: SpecOps Unable to Access the Application
Description: Specops-  Something went wrong
Cause notes:
From Root Cause Analysis PTASK2014797

Cause Code:
software issue

Cause Notes:

In order to delegate access to Specops Secure Service Desk (the service desk password reset component of Specops) groups and users are added to the "Specops Authentication User Administration" group in the amfam.com domain. Previously our team had decided to delegate access to Specops Secure Service Desk to the following teams: EIAM - PPM, EIAM Operations, Cyber Squad, Agency Service Desk, and Cyber SOC. In order to proide this access we create the following five groups: Specops-CyberSquad-Users-US, Specops-EIAMPPM-Users-US, Specops-EIAMOperations-Users-US, Specops-CyberSOC-Users-US, and Specops-AgencyServiceDesk-Users-US. Those groups were added to the Specops Authentication User Administration group. When the old Specops-ServiceDesk-Users-US group was removed from the Specops Authentication User Administration group it caused the major incident. The Specops authentication web was not able to view or read user data for Secure Service Desk access. We believe this was due to the Specops Authentication User Administration group being set to domain local while have corporate.amfam.com groups nested within it.
Close notes: The fix for this solution was to change the Specops Authentication User Administration group domain scope to universal which was done afterwards. This will allow the group to be read and should allow the Specops authentications web to read user data from it.

Problem statement: CFRPS-274: Rendering Exception the Signature Screen for OOS transactions due to an inactive ProducerOfRecord
Description:
Description: When agents or the business team create an OOS transaction, they encounter a rendering exception in the signature screen due to ProducerOfRecord user retired/Inactive from both PMAC's and Fusion. 

Impacts:  Both HAB and F/R products

RootCause: 
• The agent is attempting to create an OOS change using an old producer code that is already inactive or retired from both Fusion and PMACs. 
• When we click the Signature screen, we invoke PMAC's service to retrieve the ProducerOfRecord details. However, PMAC's response is returning NULL, resulting in a rendering exception in the UI (Attached PMAC's response.).

PMAC's Service endpoint: https://prdbi22.amfam.com/producerrestservice/v02/producercodes/6412/licensedproducers


Workaround: As discussed with Product team, Production IT team will run the script to update the 'ProducerOfRecord' section to reflect the current producer who is servicing the policy. Then, we will ask the business/agent to navigate to the Signature screen. Once the agent has updated all mandatory fields before clicking the bind button, the Production IT team will run a script to change back to the old producer code. After this change, the business team can proceed to bind the transaction.

Additional Details:Rec'd pc from agt Michael Grzenia in regards to the 22/23 term audit, audit was completed on 1/6/24 as well as the CTU, agt rec'd 2nd req on 1/26/24 with a due date of 2/29/24. Configuration item: ESB IT Billing and Policy - PROD
Cause notes:
HS-46536 is created for Permanent Fix and HS-46537 is created for Remediation.

Analysis:

(1) Issue is reported for WCP1006614#3 policy where AUDIT REMINDER 1 being generated and sent out to user despite manual audit being processed timely.
(2)WCP1006614#3 is expired so AUDIT REMINDER 1 with date as ‘25-JAN-24’ and ANC Audit Transaction with date as ‘10-MAR-24’ objects were procreated in Batch.
(3) User performed manual Audit on date ’06-JAN-2024’ which is before AUDIT REMINDER 1 and ANC Audit Transaction date and so ideally both objects should have been terminated and no output should be triggered.
(4) But instead, out of the two objects only ANC Audit Transaction object got Terminated and AUDIT REMINDER 1 is not terminated.
(5)We were able to recreate this issue on Stage environment on following WCP1016740#1 policy.
(6) We checked and there is no code to Terminate AUDIT REMINDER 1 object specified in PKG_POLICY_PREMIUM_AUDIT.UPDATE_ANC_OBJECT
(7)This is an issue and needs to be fixed.
(8)On further check If a cancelled policy is reinstated than in this case AUDIT REMINDER 1 is terminated along with ANC Audit Transaction object and new objects are procreated with the new dates where still similar issue has occurred.
(9)Please check for GA state as it has AUDIT REMINDER 2 as well.

Issue Reproduced: Y on Stage environment WCP1016740#1

Impacted Area: WC

Query:

select distinct BE_POLICY_NO, BE_POLICY_RENEW_NO
from stg_core.batch_executor a ,stg_core.endr_interface b
where b.EI_AUDIT_FLAG='Y'
and a.be_policy_no=b.ei_policy_no
and a.be_policy_renew_no=b.ei_policy_renew_no
and a.BE_STATUS='CO'
and a.BE_OBJECT_NAME in ('AUDIT_REMINDER_1')
and TRUNC(a.BE_EXECUTIONDATE) > TRUNC(b.EI_ENDR_PROCESS_DATE)
and b.EI_PROCESSED_FLAG='Y'
and exists (select 1 from stg_core.batch_executor c
where c.be_policy_no=a.be_policy_no
and c.be_policy_renew_no=a.be_policy_renew_no
and c.BE_OBJECT_NAME in ('PREMIUMAUDIT_TRANSACTION')
and c.BE_STATUS='TR');

2829 policies.
Please note a single policy could have multiple terms impacted due to this issue.

Acceptance Criteria:

AUDIT REMINDER 1 and AUDIT REMINDER 2 should not be triggered if a manual Audit has successfully been performed by user.

  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  

Technical Solution:

Outcome of 4/25/24 Meeting:
ClaimCenter automatically opens exposures at first notice of loss when coverage exists and there are no coverage issues.

When an exposure is opened reserves are automatically created based on coverage, state and operating company.

MSA PAC “locks” claim information once a financial transaction occurs.

These truths lead to a situation where, if the loss cause of a claim changes after the 3 above actions occur; it seems MSAs stat data in PAC reflects the incorrect Loss Cause code.

In 2021 when MSA was onboarded to ClaimCenter the claim data “lock” PAC functionality was discussed in depth. We discussed Loss Cause Detailed Loss Cause changes as well as Date of Loss changes.

It was determined that Date of Loss changes would be shut off for MSA policy source claims as the changes to PAC to accommodate DOL changes would not be feasible.

The same approach was not taken for Loss Cause Detailed Loss Cause changes. Claims business pushed back as Loss Cause frequently changes once investigation is complete. Ex. Water losses being changed to Roof Leak losses 01-007-225033

Based on decision 66 from MSA implementation on Enterprise ClaimCenter - Link PAC was to make a change to accept updates to the Loss Cause code when it is updated after a financial transaction has occurred.

Based on errors reported in this defect, there seems to be an issue with the stat data when Loss Cause code is changed in ClaimCenter. This issue will need to be researched further by the MSA PAC Team. Claim examples: 01-007-225033(changed from Water to Other – Roof Leak), 01-006-718190 (changed from Water to Wind – Wind Driven Water)

We will spin off a new defect to handle the stat code retrieval issue for Homeowners Gold. This issue appears to be unrelated to the issue reported in this defect. We discovered this new issue while researching stat coding discrepancies.

This incident was started because there was a configuration change made within PMACS by adding a new Carrier (underwriting company). When a new carrier is added it needs to coincide with a code deploy that also has the new value or else it causes null pointer exceptions.

There were 3 producers that had the appointments added and when calling the rest service /producers/{id}/authorities (this is not the license check) it caused an exception and because of that switched the service into a backup mode by reading data from a file instead of from the db. This backup mode keeps services working if we have db problems.

The fact that the Carrier was added on Friday was just a coincidence and not related to the release we had Friday night.

The reason we got the incident is that we newly implemented to ALSO use the file backup solution if the agent validation service (the background service for license check). There was a bug that when the ping service is checking this agent validation service and we are in backup mode we would not be pinging the agent validation service but instead use the file like normal calls that were being made. This path caused the ping operation to report failure even though the validation service was working well.

We were able to remove the data for new Carrier and see to it that the new data will not be entered until after our next release when we will have knowledge of the carrier in the code release.

Description:

<ModelVariable>

                           <Value>57.14</Value>

                        <ModelVariable>
                           <Name>Liencount</Name>
                           <Value>57.14</Value>
                        </ModelVariable>

This will ensure that the renewal model score is calculated within range

Good afternoon,

It appears the subcontracting part of ticket HS-44386, that was delivered in January release, is not functioning.  Below is a summary of what i found through a series of 68 test cases in stage and 2 tests in production (validated in stage, and re-validated in prod).

The quotes from production are:
• QP00212833 - subcontracting cost was 60k, sales 200k, and only owner payroll.  Should have triggered a referral for subcontracting being over 25% of the annual sales, but there was no referral.  Har file attached.
• QP00212836 - subcontracting cost was 90k, sales 90k, and only owner payroll.  Should have triggered a DNQ for subcontracting being over 35% of annual sales (it was 100%), but there was no referral or dnq.  Har file attached.

Summary of my findings regarding defects of the ticket:
• Contracting classes are not triggering referrals or DNQ regardless of the percentage of subcontracting to sales. Assuming this is because contracting classes are payroll based and not sales based.
o Example: 60k subcontracting, 200k sales, and owner only payroll - no referral even though subcontracting cost is 30% of the sales and 200% of the payroll amount on the quote.
o Example: 900k subcontracting, 900k sales, and owner only payroll - received a referral for subcontracting being over 100k, but did not get a dnq for subcontracting over 35% of sales
• Non-contracting classes that ask about subcontracting (glass dealers and glazers for example that is mercantile and sales based) is working since the classification is sales based rather than payroll based - triggering dnq over 25%
• Referral for subcontracting limits over 100k is working for all classes that offer subcontracting
• CG 22 94 is not attaching when subcontracting is added (this is by design, some states attach automatically when subcontracting is NOT selected, so this is a desired function)
• Subcontracting class is being added for almost all classes as it should be (edge case that failed that I'm reporting separately)

CU00001967 Issue || Homesite ESB Issue: Commercial Tech Ops || ESB – Other.
The AmFam policyholder notice(CU 79 06) is attaching when it should not along with the MSA policyholder notice(CU 79 07) which should be attached, and why only the AmFam PHN is listed on the forms schedule and MSA policyholder notice is not getting printed.

Analysis:

For CU00001967,
Issue 1:
(1) AmFam policyholder notice(CU 79 06) is attaching along with the MSA policyholder notice(CU 79 07).
(2) This is incorrect as AmFam policyholder notice(CU 79 06) should not attach along with the MSA policyholder notice(CU 79 07).
(3) Here attachment criteria of CU-9529294-22022 rule needs to be updated to fix this.

Issue 2:
(1) MSA policyholder notice is not getting printed in the declaration page.
(2) CU 79 07 05 23 should be a form and not document.
(3)Here as a fix we will have to
(1)Expire CU 79 07 05 23.
(2)Create a new form with Category as form.
(3)Add entry in IEL_HS_MIC_PRINTORDER, similar to CU 79 06 01 21.

Impacted Area : CU

 

Acceptance criteria:

(1)AmFam policyholder notice(CU 79 06) should not attach along with the MSA policyholder notice(CU 79 07).
(2) MSA policyholder notice should get printed on the dec page. 

Technical Solution:

For Issue 1,
Here attachment criteria of CU-9529294-22022 rule needs to be updated to fix.
Attachment query should have the condition of Prior UW company = AFMIC or AFIC

For Issue 2,
Here as a fix we will have to
(1)Expire CU 79 07 05 23.
(2)Create a new form with Category as form.
(3)Add entry in IEL_HS_MIC_PRINTORDER, similar to CU 79 06 01 21.
